actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.millionverifier_delete_file.desc: Permanently deletes a bulk verification file and its results.
actions.millionverifier_delete_file.prop: ID of a bulk file, e.g. "32502003". Upload Emails for Bulk Verification and List Bulk Files return it as file_id.
Downloads the verification results of a bulk file as rows.
ID of a bulk file, e.g. "32502003". Upload Emails for Bulk Verification and List Bulk Files return it as file_id.
Which results to include: ok, ok_and_catch_all, unknown, invalid, all, custom. "custom" uses Statuses, Free and Role.
With filter "custom" only: "true" for free-provider emails only, "false" to exclude them. Empty includes both.
With filter "custom" only: "true" for role emails (info@, sales@) only, "false" to exclude them. Empty includes both.
With filter "custom" only: results to include, from ok, catch_all, unknown, invalid, disposable. Empty includes all.
actions.millionverifier_get_credits.desc: Returns the account's remaining verification credits.
actions.millionverifier_get_file.descrip: Returns the status, progress and result counts of a bulk verification file.
actions.millionverifier_get_file.props.f: ID of a bulk file, e.g. "32502003". Upload Emails for Bulk Verification and List Bulk Files return it as file_id.
actions.millionverifier_list_files.descr: Lists bulk verification files, newest first, with optional filters.
actions.millionverifier_list_files.props: Only files created after this time, format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" (UTC), e.g. "2026-01-01 00:00:00".
Only files created before this time, format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss".
Only files that failed ("true") or did not fail ("false"). Leave empty for both.
Files per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 50.
Only files whose name contains this text.
Number of files to skip, for paging. Defaults to 0.
Only files at least this percent done (0-100).
Only files at most this percent done (0-100).
Only files in these states: in_progress, error, finished, canceled, paused, in_queue_to_start.
Only files updated after this time, format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss".
Only files updated before this time, format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss".
actions.millionverifier_stop_file.descri: Cancels a bulk verification file that is still in progress.
ID of a bulk file, e.g. "32502003". Upload Emails for Bulk Verification and List Bulk Files return it as file_id.
actions.millionverifier_upload_file.desc: Uploads a list of email addresses as a file and starts bulk verification.
actions.millionverifier_upload_file.prop: The email addresses to verify, one per item.
Name for the uploaded file, shown in MillionVerifier and usable with List Bulk Files. Defaults to "emails.txt".
actions.millionverifier_verify_email.des: Verifies one email address in real time and returns its deliverability result.
actions.millionverifier_verify_email.pro: The email address to verify, e.g. "jane@example.com".
Seconds to wait for the recipient mail server, between 2 and 60. Defaults to 20.
actions.verifyEmail.description: Verify email address using Million Verifier API
